# Config: SelfUpdate

> **Reader:** `SelfUpdate` (`config/SelfUpdate.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.SelfUpdate` · category Maintenance

axiom updates: Updates come from the repository axiom was cloned from: its release tags, or its main branch. An update only fast-forwards: a clone with changed files or commits of its own is never touched.

### `SelfUpdate`

- **`SelfUpdate.mode`** · string = "notify" · enum auto|notify|off
  - Updates: Checked when the shell starts and once a day. Update automatically installs an update and notifies you; Notify me sends a notification that opens this page. Off never checks.
